title: Switch mimid's Chat/kick|ban|unban to ChatBan objects and the kickMembers patch key
description: jmap-chat-spec 516c61b adds ChatBan (base draft) and kickMembers (jmap-chat-mimi §Moderation). Waiting on the crate-jmap session for the ChatBan type, handlers, MemoryBackend support and ChatBackend hooks (requested 2026-11-19, Mark's choice). Then mimid-agent-jmap maps ChatBan create/destroy to Agent::ban/unban and kickMembers to Agent::kick, and drops the invented methods (decision mimid-1wgh.62); bump the crate-jmap pin.
